blind.description: No text or labels can be read on any of the renders. The model is a stylized architectural flying buttress consisting of a tall upright square pier on the right with a molded base, royal-blue inset panels, and a high-relief carving of a heater shield over a broad vertical sword, crowned by a castellated capital with miniature pointed finials. A thick curved half-arch springs from near the top of the pier and sweeps downward to a stout stepped rectangular footing block on the left, leaving an open arched space underneath. The sides of the arch feature royal-blue panels decorated with silver heater-shield/diamond reliefs and a row of diamond-pointed finials along the top spine. All surfaces are solid, manifold, and continuous, with no shards, spikes, blobs, holes, or floating flakes. Nothing hovers unattached, and nothing is melted or fused. It stands on its own two integrated rectangular bases which sit flat on the floor, with no added ground slab, disc, or plinth. Materials and colors consist of pale silver-grey stone masonry with royal-blue painted insets and silver-white heraldic details. There are no plain black or unpainted areas, and there is no flame or glow.
blind.from_above: From straight above, it appears as a straight, narrow rectangular bar. On the right is the square capital of the pier with corner finials, connected to a long straight spine running to the left with a blue channel lined by white diamond-shaped studs, terminating at the slightly wider stepped rectangular footing on the far left.
blind.height_vs_figure: The tall pier stands approximately 7.5 to 8 ft tall (about 1.3 to 1.4 times the height of the 5 ft 9 in figure), and the structure spans roughly 10 ft wide across the floor (about 1.7 to 1.8 times the figure's height, spanning two 5-ft grid squares).
